top_signals.title: Ukraine says Elon Musk's Starshield service partially restored after restrictions disrupted drone missions
top_signals.summary: The Ukrainian military can again use SpaceX’s Starshield satellite service on the move, a Defense Ministry source told Recorded Future News on Thursday, days after sudden restrictions disrupted drone missions along the front line.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Aussie Dollar Falls to Lowest Since July as RBA Hike Bets Fade
top_signals.summary: The Australian dollar touched the lowest level since early July, extending its decline after domestic labor data pushed traders to scale back expectations of interest rate increases from the Reserve Bank of Australia.

top_signals.title: DeFi Development boosts CHAD dividend to 14% amid push to grow Solana holdings
top_signals.summary: DeFi Development is raising the dividend rate on its CHAD preferred stock to 14% from 13% as it taps CHAD sales to grow its Solana treasury.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: She made college ‘good debt’ for herself. Can she do the same for her daughter?
top_signals.summary: A generation ago, it was more common to put yourself through school. For reasons including rising education costs, It's a feat that's now far less manageable.
